text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is able to safely finish her 
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume aiming to be number one in 
Japan, she sets her sights on the next 
grand goal: the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming first to enter the Kisaragi Sho, 
they hit the ground running.
